capabilities.rationale: The source creates an account after purchase from an emailed password-set link; the clone must own subscriber identity to serve the dashboard the traces describe.
app.joindeleteme.com/password/forgot is a real, observed surface with its own copy and its own return path (trace ht-18).
The observed confirmation copy promises an email carrying a link to set a password; the clone renders that mail into its local outbox only and never sends.
Checkout creates a subscription order whose amount, term and quantity must persist for the confirmation and history surfaces.
The P0 journey is the paid checkout for the Single plan (traces ht-02, ht-23).
Payment is required to complete the P0 journey. The source uses Stripe-hosted iframes; the clone uses the local-sandbox adapter only, and reproduces no card field.
Subscriptions, removal records, reports and billing history must persist deterministically across a reset.
